title: How Apologizing to Someone With Less Power Than Him Builds a Godly Man's Humility
caption:
Everybody apologizes to the boss. Not everybody apologizes to the intern.

A godly man's humility isn't measured by how he treats the people who can affect his paycheck. It's measured by how fast he owns it with the ones who can't do a thing for him back.

Before honor comes humility. Go to him before he has to come to you.
